item.title: Rain and snow showers move through New Mexico into Saturday morning
item.description: Rain and mountain snow has expanded across the state this afternoon and will continue to move through overnight tonight. Snow levels are currently above 9,000′ but will lower to around 7,500′ tonight. Most of the snowfall will remain confined to the higher terrain. Little to no travel impacts are expected, especially outside of the mountains. [...]

item.title: New Mexico State Fair holding Valentine's Day sale
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – To help share the love, the New Mexico State Fair is doing a Valentine's Day sale. item.title: Albuquerque man sentenced for multiple murders
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – An Albuquerque man was in court Friday to be sentenced for multiple murders.
